summary: Host-neutral semantic Asset SDK built on the shared-types ProjectAsset and Resource contracts.
context_hints: Do not duplicate Asset shapes here; import the canonical schemas and types from @clash/shared-types
Adapters own Project Loro, Global library state, registries, storage and URL projection; this package owns semantic orchestration and validation

The browser-safe Project and personal Global Asset HTTP clients own route construction, auth headers, multipart import and response validation; the Project client additionally owns read receipts. Consumers may add Host discovery or UI caching but must not reimplement the transport
Project trash must use the authority port's atomic trash-if-unreferenced operation; never split reference checking from lifecycle mutation in the SDK
Client mutations accept ProjectAsset product facts only and never storage keys, paths, URLs or credentials

key_files.src/index.ts: Public ports, resolver and semantic client exports.
key_files.src/asset-client.ts: Validated ProjectAsset resolution, Action binding, reference, and lifecycle behavior.
key_files.src/global-asset-client.ts: Validated host-neutral Global library entry client and authority port.
key_files.src/project-asset-http-client.ts: Shared browser/Node Project Asset HTTP transport returning only canonical ResolvedAsset values and opaque observations.
key_files.src/personal-global-asset-http-client.ts: Shared browser/Node personal Global library HTTP transport returning only canonical ResolvedAsset values.

architecture_notes: Resource bytes and projections are Host-owned ports. ProjectAssetEntry remains Project Loro authority and ResolvedAsset is read-only.
